description: ICA/MCP context package for the CDP Snowflake-to-Oracle ETL Loader. Vendor-neutral. No tenant-specific identifiers.

authority.note: Executable DDL is the physical-schema authority. ICA docs are business-rule authority. Where they conflict, DDL wins.

artifacts.description: Package manifest: artifact inventory, version, owner, scope
Business term definitions: Customer, EnergyAccount, BillingAccount, Premise, Meter, MonthlyUsage
Snowflake source table definitions, schemas, and column types (authoritative DDL summary)
Oracle target table definitions, column types, constraints, and indexes
Logical entity-to-table mapping: Snowflake source → export view → Oracle target, with load order and FK dependencies
Column-level mapping matrix: source view column → Java type → transformation → Oracle table.column, merge key flags
CTE structure and JOIN logic for each export view, including deduplication (QUALIFY) and NULL propagation
All data transformations (TR-*): charge calculations, type mapping, flag derivation, audit columns
All record validation rules (VR-*) applied in Spring Batch processors; skip vs fatal classification
Reference code domains (ACCT_STATUS, CUST_TYPE, RATE_PLAN); ATTRIBUTES VARIANT schema; accepted code values
Watermark strategy: three separate records (CUSTOMER_EXPORT, CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_EXPORT, MONTHLY_USAGE_EXPORT); boundary conditions
INITIAL_LOAD_JOB rules: step order (customer → account → usage), MERGE strategy, reconciliation, concurrency
DAILY_INCREMENTAL_JOB rules: change detection, watermark-based query, zero-change run behaviour
MONTHLY_USAGE_JOB rules: intentional reject patterns (USG-INVK-*, USG-INVD-*), correction records, KWH reconciliation
Error classification (VALIDATION_ERROR/INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR/TRANSIENT_ERROR); ETL_RECORD_ERROR schema; error code catalogue
Post-job reconciliation checks (row counts, KWH sum, billed-total sum); ETL_RECONCILIATION schema; dashboard rules
Data sensitivity levels; PII exclusions; what must never appear in logs/responses/git; CORS and auth model
Performance targets, chunk sizes, Spring Boot config constraints, testing requirements, build commands
Template for adapting the pipeline to a specific utility tenant: connection, rate plans, reference codes, pre-production checklist

keyConstraints.keyAuth: PKCS#8 RSA key-pair only — no password fallback
